sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the equipment 
inspection I1, which should be performed on a weekly bases as indicated by W1 in 
the title block.

GRF (for boilers no. 5,6) 
supply flue gases at furnace bottom to control reheat outlet temperature and to 
reduce NOX. pollution

The first draft initiated by eng. Kamel Abd El-Salam Abd 
El-Rahman, tested by eng. Mohamed Ahmad Eid, accepted by general manager 
eng. El-Sayed Mohamed Ahmed, approved by eng. Mohamed Abdel Hafez Al-Sharedy: 
head sector of Cairo West Power Station,

This document revised by eng. Nageh Soliman 
 Shousha CEPC inspection & 
 quality control director, and certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim El-Dib CEPC inspection & quality control's 
 Head Sector, MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued
The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.

Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, ....etc.
Fan in service.
Tools and Equipment
Portable vibration measurement
Rags, organic fluids.
Work to be Carried Out

Clean the outside surface 
of fan

Check the vibration of FDF 
bearing at 3 directions using 
the vibro-meter.
